title: Tribal Fusion Belly Dance Flow Class - Serpentine Studies - FREE SAMPLE CLASS

method.teacher_system: The teacher guides the learner through a series of slow, isolated movements, focusing on specific body parts like the hips and spine. She uses a mirror view to allow for easy imitation and emphasizes fluid, repetitive motions to build muscle connection. The lesson progresses from basic isolations to more complex, layered movements, encouraging the learner to feel the rhythm and connect with their body.
method.signature: The teacher uses a 'mirror view' throughout the entire lesson, allowing the learner to copy her movements directly without needing to mentally flip them, which is particularly effective for complex isolations.

practices.what: The teacher guides the learner through slow, deep hip circles to open up the body and prepare for the dance.
The teacher breaks down the movement into small, manageable pieces, focusing on hip pulses to one side.
The teacher introduces an optional layer by adding a foot shuffle to the existing hip movements.
The teacher guides the learner through a spine fluidity series, focusing on breathing and controlled movement.
The teacher isolates the six parts of a body wave, breaking down the movement step-by-step.
The teacher leads a lateral body warmup, focusing on fluid, rhythmic movements to connect with the music.

adaptations.difficulty: The movement might be challenging to coordinate.
adaptations.adjustment: The teacher offers an optional layer of shuffling feet to simplify or enhance the movement.

moments.says: The teacher introduces the session by inviting the learner to perform slow hip circles to open up the body for the dance.
The teacher guides the learner through a spine fluidity series, instructing them to breathe in and out while hinging at the hips.
The teacher demonstrates a spinal wave, showing the learner how to dive down and roll through the spine.
The teacher explains the six parts of a body wave to help the learner isolate the movement.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling focused and connected to their own body.

struggles.theme: Difficulty with complex combinations and rhythm

clicked.theme: The mirror view makes it easy to follow

meant.theme: Feeling connected to the body and beautiful
